scope: Independent screenshot and source inspection; gameplay rerun is separate.
comparison_control: Both planning images show tutorial 12 boxes, width 4m, chosen height 2m, same camera/GLB arrangement and HUD sizes.
improvements: Dense repeated green cones around the path were replaced with fewer low three-leaf and five-petal clusters, making the farm read as tended ground.
Narrow path-edge shading, small pebbles and three doorstep stones connect the farmhouse and stall to the ground.
Window flower boxes, potted flowers, small market basket and fine awning edge details are visible at 390px without competing with order numbers.
Lighting is slightly warmer and softer, and restrained paper/number styling preserves the original readable HUD.
remaining_gaps: The planning plot remains small in the large landscape; harvest zoom makes its crops much clearer.
Apple trees retain the same repeated rounded GLB silhouettes and fairly firm ground shadows.
Fine basket and awning geometry is subtle at mobile size; no claim of new tree/house GLB models.

maximum_field_inheritance.source_review: Maximum crop field spans x=-4.2..4.2 and z=-4.2..4.2. Meadow leaf/flower centers use outsideField with an additional margin beyond x=5 or z outside -5.15..5.8; leaf size stays beyond the field. Path ribbons remain on the existing outside path. House/stall detail is attached to those existing outside models.
maximum_field_inheritance.camera_and_plot: updateCamera, resize, projectWorld, updatePlot and crop/harvest/input core are unchanged in game.js diff.
